title: Ticketing transaction launch certification

checkpoints.summary: Completed local deliverable: canonical refund replay certification + request-scoped purchase idempotency. Changed lib/ticketing/orders.ts (added findIdempotentPurchase), app/api/ticketing/enhanced/route.ts (dedup via helper; deduped:true and keyed Stripe session preserved), lib/ticketing/ledger.ts (writeRefundLedger/writeSaleLedger fail closed on unavailable pre-check reads; 23505/duplicate treated as duplicate acknowledgement, other insert errors throw; never infer row-absent from unreachable read), lib/ticketing/finalize.ts (refundOrderTickets returns {duplicate:true} on already-refunded RPC with zero side effects and throws on genuine errors; finalizePaidOrder returns {alreadyFinalized:true, skipped:'terminal_state'} with no re-issuance/ledger/analytics for refunded/cancelled/metadata.refund orders). Added __tests__/ticketing/refund-replay.test.ts (refund/sale ledger replay-race and fail-closed certification; refundOrderTickets duplicate/throw paths; finalizePaidOrder terminal-state no-ops) and __tests__/ticketing/purchase-idempotency.test.ts (request-scoped dedup scope, status scope, newest-wins race ordering, route contract, distributed-boundary scan). Verification: npx vitest run __tests__/ticketing = 15 files, 120 tests passed (baseline 13 files/95); focused ESLint on the 6 changed files exit 0; git diff --check exit 0; no migration authored by this lane and no hosted/webhook/Stripe execution strings in this lane's diff; scoped typecheck of changed lib + test files clean (route TS2589/TS2769 diagnostics at lines 144/286/583/735/773 confirmed identical at HEAD — pre-existing; full-repo typecheck still bounded-interrupted). DB-005 handoff note: active schema chain has NO distributed DB-unique purchase idempotency on ticket_sales (only partial unique indexes on order_number, stripe_checkout_session_id, webhook_event_id); suggested migration is a partial unique index on ticket_sales(buyer_user_id, event_id, metadata->>'idempotency_key') or a dedicated idempotency_key column; financial_transactions already provides idx_fin_tx_idempotency used by ledger replay. Request-scoped idempotency covers double-click/retry dedup locally; two concurrent FIRST requests can still both create rows until DB-005 lands. Hosted create-to-settlement lifecycle and Stripe execution remain blocked (no credentials). No git commit made; changes left in worktree for orchestrator per constraints.
